card.name: Hardcover GraphQL API
card.description: --- name: hardcover description: Query reading lists and book data from Hardcover.app via GraphQL API. Triggers when user mentions Hardcover, asks about their reading list/library, wants book progress, searches for books/authors/series, or references "currently reading", "want to read", or "books I've read". Also use for syncing reading data to other systems (Obsidian, etc.) or tracking reading goals. homepage: https://hardcover.app metadata: { "openclaw": { "emoji": "📚", "requires": { "env": ["HARDCOVER_API_TOKEN"] }, }, } ---
